name: @epoch/adapter-renderer-blender
description: Epoch Blender Sidecar Renderer adapter (W060, ACR-007/X2.0) — the EXTERNAL-PROCESS foundation behind the frozen W056 RendererAdapter seam: Blender runs as a SEPARATE PROGRAM (never linked, never embedded — the GPLv2+/GPLv3 separate-executable posture recorded in docs/rendering/blender.md) driven through a TYPED process boundary (argv-array invocations ONLY, never a shell; per-invocation timeouts; stdout/stderr byte caps; scoped workspace directory with traversal-proof slugs; typed success/failure reports whose digests the adapter RE-COMPUTES — sidecar output is untrusted until verified). The sidecar job protocol: version probe, offscene/offscreen render of the canonical W016 projection (batch evidence capture — every mesh object carries its semantic entity id as a Blender custom property), and glTF/GLB export that re-enters through the @epoch/adapter-foundation-gltf bridge before anything binds (provider-native files never become Epoch authority). The adapter class is honest about being a BATCH renderer: no interactive input translation (typed refusals), no portable view state, declared mesh asset kinds only. Blender is NOT bundled: CI verifies the full boundary against a committed test double; a real Blender binary is exercised only by the ENV-GATED live battery (EPOCH_BLENDER_PATH + EPOCH_BLENDER_LIVE=1) — never fabricated as CI-verified.

scripts.test:live: node scripts/link-local.mjs && EPOCH_BLENDER_LIVE=1 vitest run test/live-blender.test.ts
